title: TRACE-BRL
sub: A framework for evaluating UX labs, and a maturity model for the age of AI and multimodal analytics.
description: TRACE-BRL: a five-dimension maturity model for behavioural research labs, applied across 32 research initiatives. Co-authored by Riya Dutta; under review at Cognition, Technology & Work.
facts: Manuscript under review, Cognition, Technology & Work (Springer Nature)
L. Leonori, M. Ali and Y. Charalabidis
Sapienza University of Rome and the University of the Aegean

sections.title: How ready are research labs to measure behaviour?
paras: The paper looks at the measurement infrastructure available to consumer and behavioural research. It sets out five evaluative dimensions and a five-level maturity model, applies them across 32 research initiatives worldwide, and finds that most remain unequipped for multimodal behavioural measurement.
Revised after peer review at Behaviour & Information Technology, and now under review at Cognition, Technology & Work (Springer Nature). The paper will be linked here once it’s published.

sections.title: The lab side.
paras: Research internship in Behavioural and Cognitive Methods at the University of the Aegean’s ISLab, Samos (June–August 2025): eye-tracking, GSR and PPG sessions, multimodal data analysis, and a report benchmarking 25 UX labs.
